ubClass","d"."SubProject","d"."InvestmentReason","d"."InvestmentScale","d"."EnvironmentalInvestmentReason","d"."RequestingCompanyCode","d"."NetworkAssignmentType","d"."CostObject","d"."BillingPlan","d"."ControllingObjectClass","d"."FreeDefinedAttribute01","d"."FreeDefinedAttribute02","d"."FreeDefinedAttribute03","d"."FreeDefinedAttribute04","d"."FreeDefinedQuantity1","d"."FreeDefinedQuantity1Unit","d"."FreeDefinedQuantity2","d"."FreeDefinedQuantity2Unit","d"."FreeDefinedAmount1","d"."FreeDefinedAmount1Currency","d"."FreeDefinedAmount2","d"."FreeDefinedAmount2Currency","d"."FreeDefinedDate1","d"."FreeDefinedDate2","d"."FreeDefinedIndicator1","d"."FreeDefinedIndicator2","d"."StatusProfile","d"."DistributionProfile","d"."SchedldBasicEarliestEndDate","d"."SchedldBasicLatestStartDate","d"."SchedldFcstdEarliestEndDate","d"."LatestSchedldFcstdStartDate","d"."StatusCombinationCode"
